claims.original_statement: The source assumes the ambient additive category is Karoubian to separate the two colimits and the two essentially constant summands.
claims.proved_statement: Given W=colim(F direct-sum G), colim F exists exactly when the induced F-projection idempotent e on W splits, and colim G exists exactly when 1-e splits. When the sum diagram is essentially constant, the corresponding splitting also gives an explicit essential-constancy witness for that summand.
claims.hypotheses: The specified sum colimit exists in the original additive category; each individual splitting is proved equivalent to its own colimit. No splitting of the complementary idempotent is inferred without proof.
claims.propagation: The receiving derived-functor proof supplies both splittings through its stated Karoubian hypothesis. The criterion isolates the requirement at its colimit value without changing its source statement or certifying its separate cofinality proof.

claims.original_statement: Acyclic complexes with matching maps surjective in every degree have acyclic ordinal inverse limit.
claims.proved_statement: For a fixed integer N, vanishing of H^q(K_beta) for q<=N and surjectivity of K_beta^j to lim_(gamma<beta) K_gamma^j for j<=N-2 imply H^q(lim K_beta)=0 for q<=N.
claims.hypotheses: An inverse system of complexes of abelian groups over a set-sized ordinal, with exactly the displayed degree ranges at every index.
claims.propagation: The all-degree assertion follows by applying the proved statement for every N. Existing Injectives and SDGA citations retain their original Homology conclusion; a degree-range refinement of their separate theorems has not been claimed.
